title: Personal reference feed intent with APL view
description: MyFeedIntent: fetch the linked user's ranked reference feed through the existing API with their token, and show it in the M2 feed document (with a reference variant). Read the top items aloud. Gherkin covers it.

comments.text: Superseded by the rescoped M4 (Ryan, 2026-10-31): the review MVP's 'most interesting' queue replaces a generic personal feed.
